description: Two characters observe the same harbor signal from separated viewpoints.

session.personaDescription: A harbor keeper stationed in the signal tower.

interactions.content: From the tower window, I raise the blue lantern toward the eastern pier.
From the rain-dark pier, Oren sees the blue lantern and raises his gloved hand in reply.

Iris stands behind the tower glass with the blue lantern held high. Across the harbor, Oren remains on the eastern pier, looking toward the tower and answering with one raised hand; the water and distance remain between them.

characters.name: Oren
characters.description: An inspector wearing a yellow raincoat and dark gloves.

requiredSourceFacts.description: Iris is in the tower behind glass.
Oren remains on the eastern pier.
